Эторикоксиб C18H15ClN2O2S = 358.8. CAS — 202409-33-4. ATC — M01AH05. ATC Vet — QM01AH05. Adverse Effects, Treatment, and Precau- tions As for NSAIDs in general, p.96. Hypersensitivity reactions including anaphylaxis and angioedema have occurred in patients receiving etori- coxib; it should be stopped at the first signs of hyper- sensitivity. Etoricoxib should be avoided in patients with severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh score of 10 or more). Therapy should be stopped if persistently abnormal liver enzyme values are seen.
